description:
Current scope: User scope correction: PR5 delivers the foundation. Mattermost adapter publication/pinning and full real-provider partial-upload verification move to PR6 with AttachDocuments (zaq-pi3.7), using existing zaq-h2i.4.3. This supersedes earlier descriptions/comments making a published Mattermost fix a PR5 prerequisite. PR5 still completes chat boundary plumbing, SMTP, Channels.Api wiring, Channels -> Engine reporting and the grouped-failure modal. Use controlled external adapter-boundary fixtures for unavailable operations while exercising real internal planning/preparation/execution/reporting; verify current packages fail safely where unsupported. Never advertise unsupported production capabilities, guess partial-upload identities, edit ignored deps or substitute local dependency pins. Full provider compatibility must be verified in PR6 before claiming Mattermost attachment readiness. This scope correction does not authorize commits, pushes or dependency publication.

Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add: future PR6 branch restack plus backend integration tests, primarily test/zaq/agent/attachment_selection_test.exs or a focused new agent-to-channel integration suite. External prerequisite is zaq-9j8.7, the actual PR5 Channels.Api delivery route; its existing prerequisites cover executor/adapter/SMTP/reporting/Engine contracts. Do not depend on PR5 epic closure, UX approval or browser E2E for independent PR6 work.
When PR5 advances and a later request authorizes restacking, capture exact new tip/recovery ref and rebase only PR6 from old parent 6a546dc44a581013608b3d8a8f4efa138d357c38. Never modify/rebase PR5 or its working files/issues. Recheck revised PR4/PR5 contracts and minimal source ownership after restack. No restack/commit/push is authorized now.
Tests to add before implementation: real configured Agent/native selection -> Agent/Engine/Channels event boundary -> existing PR5 delivery route with only external LLM/provider/SMTP edges faked. Select A, add B, remove A and confirm only B is acquired/sent, once per attempt, with correct selected config/channel/thread; uploaded-only/rejected/uncertain facts are not delivery confirmations. Empty/no-selection/incoming-only paths remain ordinary text; selection error followed by success or clear cannot poison delivery under either transport policy. Unknown/oversize valid selections reach PR5 unchanged and transport restrictions are enforced there. Real disk ACL fixture proves a person can select/read without bypass; revocation/provenance denial blocks selection before content I/O. Provider acquisition failure, partial send, timeout, report failure and cancellation obey PR5 policy and never cause retry by PR6.
Branches/paths validated: selected SMTP and supported chat adapter, text-only/large/unknown-size, explicit false file policy, stale or absent declarations, request reuse/cancellation, original attachment indices and confirmed-only metadata. Preserve exact MIME sizing, fixed-group lifetime, failure continuation/abort and existing DeliveryConfirmation path; do not implement those mechanisms in Agent. Test a reporting failure cannot repeat provider publication.
Mocking plan: only external LLM/provider HTTP/SMTP submission boundaries. Keep real internal services, NodeRouter events, selection, preparation, execution and confirmation/persistence. Do not invent unsupported adapter declarations or copy reference dependency pins. Use current PR5 fixtures and actual adapter compatibility evidence.
Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content: record new parent boundary, recovery ref, range-diff/ancestry and fresh test results in this issue/epic; owning Agent/Channels docs for the selection/delivery boundary if needed. No duplicate stack plan file.
Action reuse assessment: reuse existing AttachDocuments, Executor, canonical Outgoing builder, NodeRouter/Event, PR4 preparation and PR5 executor/DeliveryConfirmation. Integration adds no application operation or new delivery Action. Tests prove selection side effects end at Records and actual delivery shares PR5's validated route; PR7 workflow/notification integration is excluded.

Approved scope clarification: Mattermost dependency compatibility is owned by zaq-pi3.11 and existing zaq-h2i.4.3. This task proves Agent-to-PR5 Mattermost/email integration. Browser integration follows the new web tasks and is verified by .8. Current PR6 parent is already 6a546dc44a581013608b3d8a8f4efa138d357c38; no automatic restack is required.

Implementation handoff: Scope and sequence approved by the user on 2026-11-28. This turn records the plan only; application implementation, commits, pushes, rebases and dependency publication are not performed or authorized by this planning update. Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/documentation.md, docs/conventions.md and docs/code-quality.md before execution. Read applicable service guides and module responsibilities; Agent work requires the harness-critical checks; BO work requires DESIGN.md and docs/bo-components.md. Recheck live source and dependency contracts. Preserve existing test behavior unless specifically approved. Write immediate unit/integration/property tests before corresponding code; new browser journeys wait for the human UX gate. Keep real internal boundaries, mock only external edges, and inject runtime dependencies through existing opts/context and Zaq.Config. Follow the owning validation lifecycle. PR7 owns RunAgent, NotifyPerson and notification/workflow integration.

comments.text: PR5 producer contract note: Channels.Events.build_deliver_outgoing_event now forwards explicit actor and forces confidential:true for nonempty attachments, preventing transient bytes on NodeRouter workflow-trigger stream. PR6 Agent return-hop/AttachDocuments integration must preserve Event actor and set confidentiality before routing any attachment-bearing Outgoing (or use the standardized builder). PR5 does not modify Agent producer/selection; its current return hop remains text-only. Keep provider publication/full compatibility prerequisite zaq-h2i.4.3 for PR6.

User authorized PR6 rebase onto committed PR5 on 2026-11-28. Preflight: PR6 and PR5 worktrees clean; PR6 has zero independent commits. Recovery ref backup/attach-documents-before-pr5-20261128T092334Z preserves 81629c90a555b32c6b66cbcc1339779c89f4a9d5; target PR5 6a546dc44a581013608b3d8a8f4efa138d357c38. Action reuse assessment: not applicable; branch restack only, no application operation changes. Existing setup/integration prerequisites remain open.

Rebase complete: feat/attach-documents now points to PR5 commit 6a546dc44a581013608b3d8a8f4efa138d357c38 (feat(channels): add attachment delivery execution foundation (zaq-9j8)). Use this exact SHA as PR6 previous-parent boundary for the next restack. Recovery ref backup/attach-documents-before-pr5-20261128T092334Z preserves 81629c90a555b32c6b66cbcc1339779c89f4a9d5. Verified clean PR6, PR5 ancestor, identical tracked trees, PR5 ref unchanged and git diff --check passed. No independent PR6 commits existed, so there is no child patch range to compare and no conflict resolution/source edits. No application checks run for branch-only movement; no push or new feature commit. Updated existing sibling planning stack map. This completes only the user-authorized restack, not this issue setup/provider/integration prerequisites.
